title.narrative: Strengthen 2: employment impact assessment to maximise job creation in Africa

description.narrative: The limited creation of decent jobs paired to high population growth is putting stress on the labour market in many African countries. Investment programmes have as underlying objective the creation of employment. Strengthen 2 will contribute by providing the necessary analysis on the employment outcome of envisaged investment to maximise its job potential while building capacity of stakeholders and working on harmonization of approaches among international financial institutions.
